profile:
Target system: macOS 15.6.1 (macos, arm64). Shell: zsh. Package manager: brew.
Use macOS/BSD command flags (e.g. sed -i '', stat -f, date -v), not GNU-only flags.
Installed tools: netstat, lsof, fuser, ifconfig, curl, dig, nc, jq, rsync, zip, unzip, git, docker, podman, kubectl, python3, node, ffmpeg.
Not installed (avoid): ss, ip, wget, rg, fd, fzf, tree, 7z, systemctl, journalctl, magick, htop.
